<infobox theme="Holocron">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="model"><label>Model</label></data>	
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="culture"><label>Culture</label></data>
        <data source="creators"><label>Creators</label></data>			
        <data source="created"><label>Date created</label></data>	
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Date destroyed</label></data>	
        <data source="discovered"><label>Date discovered</label></data>	
        <data source="owners"><label>Owners</label></data>
        <data source="keepers"><label>Keepers</label></data>			
        <data source="locations"><label>Locations</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical and technical specifications</header>
        <data source="size"><label>Size</label></data>	
        <data source="shape"><label>Shape</label></data>
        <data source="color"><label>Color(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="material"><label>Material(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="length"><label>Length</label></data>	
        <data source="width"><label>Width</label></data>
        <data source="height"><label>Height</label></data>
        <data source="weight"><label>Weight</label></data>	
        <data source="protection"><label>Protection type</label></data>	        
        <data source="inscription"><label>Inscriptions</label></data>	
        <data source="markings"><label>Other markings</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Usage and history</header>
        <data source="contents"><label>Contents</label></data>
        <data source="heritage"><label>Heritage</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:HolocronInfobox|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
